notes: Added missing schema/contract, ingestion API, integration hooks, and test coverage stories for append-only audit logging.

change_log.value: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition

GOV-F-004-S173.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S173.description: Define canonical audit log schema including event_id, timestamp, actor (GPT/Claude/system), action_type, input/output hashes, metadata, and hash-chain linkage. Implement Pydantic models and enforce validation contract for all audit writes.
GOV-F-004-S173.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models (Pydantic patterns); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (audit logging precedent); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S174.title: Audit Logging Core Service
GOV-F-004-S174.description: Implement centralized audit logging service responsible for constructing events, chaining hashes, enforcing append-only semantics, and writing to storage. Service must be model-agnostic and support both GPT and Claude operations.
GOV-F-004-S174.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing logging baseline); Code/Shared/machine_brain.py (event persistence patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S175.title: Audit Logging API Endpoints
GOV-F-004-S175.description: Expose internal API endpoints for audit event ingestion and controlled retrieval (admin/QA use only). Includes filtering by event type, actor, and time window, without violating append-only guarantees.
GOV-F-004-S175.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI patterns); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (controlled read access patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S176.title: System-Wide Audit Integration Hooks
GOV-F-004-S176.description: Integrate audit logging into key execution points including tool_router, safety_service, consent_service, and GPT/Claude orchestration loop to ensure all critical operations emit audit events.
GOV-F-004-S176.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (governed execution); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/shared/safety/safety_service.py (incident logging precedent); Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (model orchestration); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S177.title: Audit Logging Test Suite
GOV-F-004-S177.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating append-only enforcement, schema validation, hash-chain integrity, redaction compliance, and end-to-end event capture across GPT and Claude flows.
